description: This file contains utility functions for object manipulation, specifically 'omit' and 'pick' functions for selecting or excluding properties from objects.

methods.name: export function omit<T extends object, U extends (keyof T)[]>( omit
methods.description: Creates a new object by excluding specified keys from the original object.

methods.name: export function pick<T extends object, U extends (keyof T)[]>( pick
methods.description: Creates a new object containing only the specified keys from the original object.

ctags.name: omit
ctags.pattern: /^export function omit<T extends object, U extends (keyof T)[]>($/

ctags.name: pick
ctags.pattern: /^export function pick<T extends object, U extends (keyof T)[]>($/
